card.name: Healthcare providers are encouraged to
card.fires_on: The word "encouraged" after "strongly" or "are" in sentences telling healthcare providers what they are urged to do, such as REMS education or pregnancy registry enrollment. It also fires weakly on a few word-internal pieces such as "age" in "Dosage".

modes.label: Providers encouraged to act
modes.description: "encouraged" in a sentence where healthcare providers are urged to take an action, often followed by a list.
modes.example: Healthcare providers are strongly<< encouraged>> to do all of the following: •

modes.label: Registry enrollment prompt
modes.description: "encouraged" in a sentence asking providers to register patients in a pregnancy registry.
modes.example: Healthcare providers are<< encouraged>> to register patients by calling the National Pregnancy

modes.label: Inside drug or section words
modes.description: Partway through a longer word, such as "Dosage" in a cross-reference or the start of "betamethasone".
modes.example: expose patients to radiation [see Dos<<age>> and Administration ( 2.7 )

card.writes: The promoted tokens relate to "trigger" and are not clearly tied to this pattern, so the output effect is unclear.
